how: Answers a read session must refuse without changing, and a few it must take, so that refusing everything cannot pass. Every answer is fed to a session at the cursor in before, holding a message too large and told there is more; a refused one leaves all of that exactly as it was, and a taken one carries the messages counted and leaves the cursor at after. The C suite reads this through test/answers.h, written by tools/make-answers.py; the Python suites read it directly. From the deep health check of 21 September 2026: invalid JSON and messages of the wrong shape moved the cursor, on the C and on MicroPython, and reset:false read as a reset.

refused.what: a bare word where a value belongs
an escape that is not JSON's
a unicode escape without its four hex digits
a unicode escape cut off by the end of the string
a control character in the raw inside a string
a string that never closes
a cursor with a leading zero
a cursor with a leading plus
a cursor with a point and nothing after it
a cursor in exponent form
a cursor with a fraction
a literal that is nearly one
a literal in capitals
a number where a name belongs
a string with no name before it
nested deeper than any answer goes
a message that is null
a message that is a number
a message that is a string
a message that is a list
a message with nothing in it
a message whose seq is a string
a message whose seq counts backwards
a message with no seq
a message with no body
a message whose body is not text
one message that is one and one that is not: nothing is taken
a reset that is false
a reset that is true
a reset that is an empty object
a reset whose after is a string
a reset with no newest
more that is null
a too_large whose bytes is a string
a too_large whose bytes counts backwards

taken.what: a plain answer, with the fields the service sends around the messages
one message with every field, and space before a comma
two messages, with the escapes JSON allows in a body
a reset in its documented shape hands back a lower cursor
taken.answer: {"exists":true,"messages":[{"seq":1,"body":"new"}],"next":1,"reset":{"after":40,"newest":1,"what":"the cursor belongs to an earlier thread"}}

taken.what: a lower cursor without a reset is not followed
nested as deep as an answer may go
a note, and whitespace of every kind between the tokens
